Pointsman は `/mcp` で Model Context Protocol(MCP)を提供します。AI エージェントは自分で判断する代わりに、Pointsman のプロファイルに判定を頼めます。接続方法は [MCP サーバー](../../mcp.md)で説明しています。

コードから取り込んだ説明文は英語のままです。

## `list_profiles`

List the decision profiles you can use: their questions, answer options and possible actions.

引数はありません。

## `explain_profile`

Explain a decision profile in plain sentences: what the AI is asked, which facts and earlier decisions it uses, and each rule as "If ..., the action is ...". Show the text to the person who approves the profile.

| 引数 | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `profile` | string | はい | Profile id from list_profiles |
| `lang` | "en" \| "ja" | いいえ | Language of the sentences (default en) |
| `version` | integer | いいえ | A published version (default: the latest) |

## `replay_profile`

Try a changed policy on the decisions already made: what the new rules would have decided on the last logged decisions of a profile version, with the logged answers and facts (no model is called). Returns how many actions would change, from what to what, how often they would match what a person answered, and the changed decisions. Only the policy may change; send questions, facts and requires too to check that they are the same.

| 引数 | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `profile` | string | はい | Profile id from list_profiles |
| `policy` | object | はい | The new policy: { rules: [{ when, action }], default, people_check?, people_answers? } |
| `version` | integer | いいえ | The published version to replay (default: the latest) |
| `limit` | integer | いいえ | How many of the newest decisions (default 200) |
| `questions` | array | いいえ | The draft's questions, to check they did not change |
| `facts` | array | いいえ | The draft's facts, to check they did not change |
| `requires` | array | いいえ | The draft's requires, to check they did not change |

## `decide`

Ask a decision profile. Returns typed answers with probabilities and the action to take (for example "auto", or "review" when a person should decide). Use list_profiles first. For profiles with input fields, send state as an object with those fields under the names the profile expects.

| 引数 | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `profile` | string | はい | Profile id from list_profiles |
| `state` | string \| object | はい | What to decide about: text, or a JSON object |
| `ref` | string | いいえ | Your reference for this decision, for example an issue URL |
| `decisions` | object | いいえ | For profiles with requires: the decision_id of each earlier decision, by the name in requires. Needs ref. |
| `idempotency_key` | string | いいえ | Send the same key again to get the same decision instead of a new one |

## `get_decision`

Get a decision by id: answers, action, profile version, model, review status and feedback.

| 引数 | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `decision_id` | string | はい | decision_id returned by decide |

## `submit_feedback`

Correct a decision: give the right answer for one or more of its questions. Recorded in your name and used to measure how often the profile is right.

OAuth でログインした人だけが使えます。API トークンでは使えません。

| 引数 | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `decision_id` | string | はい | decision_id returned by decide |
| `correct` | object | はい | The right answers, by question name, for example {"team": "frontend"} |
| `note` | string | いいえ | Why, in a sentence |
